verdict.rationale: The evidence documents other add-on check types: PEP & Sanctions, adverse media, ongoing monitoring, biometric liveness and NFC document reading. Nothing in the pack documents phone or carrier checks, email risk, address history or device fingerprinting as check types. Those other checks are different capabilities and do not transfer to this story, so the axis applies to an identity-verification product but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enrich verifications with phone, email, and device risk signals — carrier checks, address history, device fingerprint — as additional documented check types
